$comment: Thin-P9 motion template v1. Eligibility keys on the one initiative predicate this product observes. The AI-infrastructure specifics a real qualification would need are declared as missing context, not fabricated: no predicate records GPU estate, workload type or accelerator vendor.
name: AI platform growth
objective: Pursue accounts whose declared strategic initiative points at AI workloads, where a platform and accelerator partner motion applies.

motion_v1.objective: Pursue accounts whose declared strategic initiative points at AI workloads, where a platform and accelerator partner motion applies.

requires.because: the account has declared an initiative that names AI workloads

requiresContext: Whether the account operates GPU infrastructure today — no predicate records accelerator estate.
Which workloads are in scope (training, fine-tuning, inference) — unobserved.
Whether an accelerator vendor relationship already exists — `partner_relationship_exists` holds no observations.
motion_v1.goalTemplate: Determine what {{company}} actually needs to run its declared AI initiative in production, and whether a platform-plus-accelerator motion fits.
motion_v1.campaignGuidance: Open on the initiative the account has already declared, not on the technology stack. The first conversation is about what has to run in production and what is blocking it.
measurementAssociations: An opportunity opened on this account in the AI platform category after application — association only.
Evidence added that records accelerator estate, which would close the largest missing-context gap.

personas.primary: VP Data / Head of AI Platform

cta.offer: Workload readiness review for the declared initiative
cta.fallback: Reference architecture for the stated workload class

seller_cadence.action: Confirm the declared initiative and its production timeline
Workload readiness conversation with the platform owner
Joint architecture session with the accelerator partner
